sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: Slice of Life delivers an immersive narrative-driven adventure with 15+ branching story paths. The Unity-based architecture achieves 60fps gameplay with smooth NavMesh character movement, Inky dialogue integration, and a comprehensive quest system supporting meaningful player choices.

sections.title: Game Development Success
highlights: 15+ unique branching narrative paths with meaningful choices
60fps gameplay performance with optimized NavMesh pathfinding
Inky dialogue system enabling dynamic story progression
Comprehensive save/load system with multiple slots

sections.title: Technical Excellence
sections.summary: Slice of Life showcases advanced Unity development including ScriptableObject-based quest management, blend tree animations for smooth character movement, and UI Toolkit integration. The modular architecture enables rapid content iteration and story expansion.
